title: Star Formation Efficiency in Nearby Galaxies Revealed with a New CO-to-H<SUB>2</SUB> Conversion Factor Prescription
question: How does the CO-to-H2 conversion factor (alpha_CO) depend on local CO velocity dispersion at 150 pc scales, and how does a velocity-dispersion-based alpha_CO prescription change the star formation efficiency (depletion time) in centers and disks of 65 PHANGS galaxies

data.angular_resolution: CO(2–1) beam sizes of 150 pc or smaller

what.value: Database of multi-wavelength measurements in 1.5 kpc hexagonal apertures (velocity dispersion at 150 pc, CO(2–1) intensity, Sigma_star, Sigma_SFR, metallicity)

evidence.quote: leveraging a database developed by (cite: 2022AJ....164...43S)
we extract multiple physical quantities in matched hexagonal apertures with fixed sizes of 1.5 kpc

what.value: Dust-based alpha_CO measurements at 2 kpc resolution for 41 galaxies (12 PHANGS galaxies used)

evidence.quote: The authors assumed a constant dust-to-metals ratio to constrain the total gas mass with dust and metallicity measurements.
which have dust-inferred $\alpha_\mathrm{CO}$ values at kpc scales (from (cite: 2023arXiv231100407C)

what.value: Stellar bar classification of PHANGS galaxies

evidence.quote: we adopt the classification of stellar bars for PHANGS galaxies (cite: 2021A&A...656A.133Q)

what.value: PG16S (S-calibration) gas-phase metallicity used for the 12 galaxies with dust-based alpha_CO

evidence.quote: is based on the S-calibration in (cite: 2016MNRAS.457.3678P)

what.value: Purely metallicity-dependent alpha_CO prescription used for comparison

evidence.quote: the purely metallicity-dependent $\alpha_\mathrm{CO}$ prescription from (cite: 2017MNRAS.464.3315A)

what.value: Tentative alpha_CO prescription combining metallicity and stellar mass surface density, used for comparison (author citation marker missing in the paper text)

evidence.quote: also suggested a tentative prescription

external_data.citation: citation marker not preserved in the paper text

recipe.goal: Assemble PHANGS measurements in 1.5 kpc apertures
recipe.method: Extract velocity dispersion, CO(2–1) intensity, stellar mass surface density, SFR surface density and metallicity from the Sun et al. database in matched hexagonal apertures
key_parameters: Sample: 65 galaxies, the overlap of the bar classification and the Sun et al. database
Centers: central ~2 kpc-sized aperture at R_gal=0; disks are the remaining measurements

recipe.goal: Match dust-based alpha_CO to velocity dispersion and define the complete regime
recipe.method: Nearest-neighbor matching of 2 kpc alpha_CO measurements to the intensity-weighted 150 pc velocity dispersion averaged over 1.5 kpc apertures; completeness per bin as fraction of pixels with reliable alpha_CO
key_parameters: alpha_CO data coverage insufficient for velocity dispersion below ~3 km/s; metallicity completeness drops below Z' ~0.6
assumptions: CO(2–1)/(1–0) ratio R21 = 0.65 used to convert alpha_CO(2-1) to alpha_CO(1-0)

recipe.goal: Fit alpha_CO versus velocity dispersion power law
recipe.method: Least-squares fit in log-log space of the complete-regime data (~1600 points from 12 galaxies) with scipy curve_fit
key_parameters: Fit: log alpha_CO = -0.81 log <dv>_150pc + 1.05 (alpha_CO in Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1, dv in km/s)

recipe.goal: Compare with metallicity- and Sigma_star-based prescriptions
recipe.method: Fit alpha_CO versus Z', compare residuals of each fit against the other variable, and compare predictions of the two prescriptions on PHANGS galaxies using kpc-scale Z' and Sigma_star
assumptions: Sigma_mol neglected in the Sigma_star-based prescription because Sigma_mol << Sigma_star
PG16S-based Z' for the 12 galaxies; PP04-based Z' across the full sample

recipe.goal: Derive depletion times in the 12 galaxy centers
recipe.method: t_dep = Sigma_mol / Sigma_SFR = alpha_CO * I_CO / Sigma_SFR using measured alpha_CO versus MW alpha_CO
assumptions: Standard MW alpha_CO of 4.35 (6.7 for alpha_CO(2-1)) Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1

recipe.goal: Apply prescriptions to all 65 galaxies and compare t_dep
recipe.method: Compute Sigma_mol and t_dep with four alpha_CO prescriptions (MW, metallicity-based, Sigma_star-based, this work) and compare distributions in barred/non-barred centers and disks, plus the molecular Kennicutt-Schmidt relation
key_parameters: Measurements at 1.5 kpc scale across all 65 galaxies

score_reason: Inputs are published PHANGS products and the fit is a simple power law with numeric results, but data location, matching details and comparison prescription implementations are not given in this paper.
rediscovery_reason: PHANGS-ALMA derived products and the dust-based alpha_CO measurements are public published works; the main fit and depletion-time results are numeric and the analysis is a simple fit, though matching details must be inferred.
